subject: Post-demo recap: SDK onboarding, auth routing, and 5xx repro plan
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@orionhealth.co>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo recap: SDK onboarding, auth routing, and 5xx repro plan

Hi Liam —

Thanks again for the demo today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum on the PoC: 

- What we covered: SDK install (Python/Node), structured tool-calling example for patient-summary generation, embedding & re-ranker concept for historical notes.
- Immediate blocker you hit: intermittent 5xx (502/503) when calling the /v1/generate endpoint from your staging cluster via the company proxy.
- Hypothesis: auth routing + payload size spike (long context + embeddings call in same request) is causing the gateway to hit a timeout or an upstream retry loop.

Action items I'm proposing: 
1) Repro plan (Connor + Neha): collect a minimal repro payload and run from an environment that bypasses the proxy (we'll also try from your same proxy to compare). Please see the attached repro_payload.jsonl with a sanitized example.
2) Neha will share a short checklist for SDK environment variables and token routing rules (attached: sdk-setup-checklist.pdf).
3) Schedule a 60-minute troubleshooting session tomorrow to run live traces and capture server spans (I'll include a redwood engineer + your platform lead).

If you can send the earliest time that works for your DevOps team, I'll lock it in. Also, if Karuna wants to include anyone from Medora who manages the proxy, please CC them.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: sdk-setup-checklist.pdf, repro_payload.jsonl, postcall-recording-20260929.mp3

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@orionhealth.co>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karuna Singh <karuna.singh@medora.io>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap: SDK onboarding, auth routing, and 5xx repro plan

Aditya —

Thanks for the concise plan. We did capture a few of the 502s in our staging logs; attaching the most recent server traces (server-traces-20260929.zip). A couple notes from our side: 

- The staging environment uses an ingress proxy that performs mutual TLS with our upstreams. The proxy is configured to retry idempotent requests; we suspect the retry semantics might interact poorly with streaming/generator endpoints.
- One recurring pattern: a generate request that also kicks off an embeddings call (we're doing a synchronous call after generation to rerank results) seems to align with the timing of the 502 in the logs.

We can make time for a troubleshooting call tomorrow at 11:00 CET (2:00 PDT). Karuna will join to represent Medora's integration team (they manage the proxy).

Liam
Platform Lead | Orion Health
liam.oconnor@orionhealth.co

Attachment: server-traces-20260929.zip

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@orionhealth.co>, Karuna Singh <karuna.singh@medora.io>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap: SDK onboarding, auth routing, and 5xx repro plan

Thanks, team — adding a few technical specifics and what we'll try during the triage call: 

- Please confirm the exact curl equivalent you used. If possible, include the Authorization header redacted (we just need the header name and routing metadata). Example I'd like them to run during the call: 

  curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
    -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" 
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
    -d '{"model":"rdw-extended-13b","input":"<sanitized clinical note>","stream":false}' 

- We'll test three configurations during the call: 1) direct from a VM that bypasses the proxy, 2) from the same staging VM via the proxy, 3) with embeddings separated into an async job (to see if the sync embeddings call is the trigger).
- I'll enable additional tracing on our side to capture span ids; please have the staging traces available so we can map spans.

Connor, can you prepare a small Node/Python snippet to reproduce the combined generate+embed request pattern (keep it <1500 tokens) and attach before the call? I'm attaching a short checklist and the repro payload that Liam can run.

-Neha
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai

Attachments: sdk-setup-checklist.pdf, repro_payload.jsonl

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@orionhealth.co>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Karuna Singh <karuna.singh@medora.io>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 13:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap: SDK onboarding, auth routing, and 5xx repro plan

Perfect — call confirmed for tomorrow 11:00 CET / 02:00 PDT. Agenda: quick replay of the failure, reproduce with the three configs Neha listed, capture spans, and agree on a mitigation (short-term: disable proxy retries for generator endpoints; medium-term: change embedding flow to async and add a redundant fallback model).

Pre-call checklist for your team (Liam / Karuna):
- Have the staging VM ready with curl and the repro_payload.jsonl (sanitized examples attached).
- If possible, run the direct curl once and paste the full request/response headers into the chat before we start.
- If Medora can temporarily allow us to run a single direct call (mutual TLS credentials we provide), that will speed root-cause.

Connor — thanks in advance for the reproduce scripts. Marissa, I'm looping you in so CS can be aware of the potential SLA hit and the proposed mitigation paths. We'll capture notes and follow up with a short playbook after the session.

Thanks all — looking forward to the call.

Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai

Attachments: postcall-recording-20260929.mp3, server-traces-20260929.zip
